overview_description.description: Farmako is a healthcare company that focuses on medicine delivery and digital health services. It provides medicine delivery in about 30 minutes. The company also offers tools that process prescriptions and support pharmacy operations. It starts as an AI-based EMR product for doctors and later shifts toward quick medicine delivery. It works with online consultations and pharmacy workflows.

about_short_description.short_description: Farmako is an application that delivers medicines and wellness products 24/7 along with digital healthcare services.

product.name: Medicine Delivery Service
product.description: A service that facilitates the purchase and doorstep delivery of prescribed pharmaceutical products in select cities across India.

product.name: Lab Test Booking Service
product.description: A platform feature enabling users to book diagnostic lab tests through third-party labs via the Farmako application.

product.name: Online Medical Consultation
product.description: A service for booking online appointments with registered medical professionals for medical advice and consultation.

product.name: AI Chatbot for Medical Queries
product.description: An AI-powered chatbot that provides algorithmically generated responses to user health-related queries based on publicly available data.

product.name: Health Record Keeping Portal
product.description: A digital platform for users to store, manage, and share their health and medical records securely with affiliated hospitals and practitioners.
